title: Security and troubleshooting

questions.prompt: In a legacy application, which principle best applies to “Common ASP Errors”?
options: Assume a successful example proves every failure path is safe.
Enforce the control server-side and verify the denial/failure behavior.
Trust browser-supplied values without validation.
Enable detailed internal errors for all public visitors.
questions.answer_key: Enforce the control server-side and verify the denial/failure behavior.
questions.explanation: The course treats common asp errors as a part of a reproducible, security-aware maintenance workflow. Verify specific IIS/provider behavior with the target environment.
